Policy & curriculum

NCF-SE 2023 Ready: built for experiential learning policy.

The National Education Policy shifts focus from rote recall to competency-based experiential learning. Learniz provides the concrete classroom tools required to satisfy these mandates without burdening faculty.

  • Experiential pedagogy. Students manipulate physical constants, test hypotheses and deduce scientific laws.
  • Continuous formative assessment. Low-stakes, frequent checks replace intimidating term-end bottlenecks.
  • Parent Confidence and transparent reporting. Parents view subject mastery trajectories rather than arbitrary letter grades.
